A LITTLE CIRCLE TO MAKE YOUR OWN

Woodland Cottage Mandala Coloring Page

Step into a little woodland home framed by repeating leaf shapes and diamonds. The cottage adds a few smaller details while the outer rings remain open and simple.

One drawing · A4 or Letter · Portrait
White margins and a smaller drawing help prevent cropped edges.

Inside this little mandala

A curved roof, windows and a front door make the cottage easy to recognize. A short path leads between two mushrooms. Outside the scene, leaf shapes and diamonds repeat in circular rings to turn the tiny home into a mandala.

A coloring idea to try

Pick a roof color first, then choose a contrasting door. Repeat one color on the diamonds and alternate two shades on the outer leaf shapes.

Make a little moment of it

Imagine who lives in the cottage. Children can tell a little story while coloring, or add their own sky and garden colors inside the central scene.

Use pencils or crayons for the smaller sections. Print on paper suited to your materials, and put a protective sheet underneath if using markers. Printing is free for home and classroom use; please link to this page when sharing the design online.
